about: App preview (29.2 s, real time): the owner's iPhone screen recording from 2026-11-22, already cut to length: inputs, the route and its details, a drive's preview and directions, back to Home, Adjust visits, Home, the new plan, and directions again. Before cutting, the AssistiveTouch button was removed from every frame (its overlay was measured ring by ring against the plain grey and teal backgrounds behind it, then subtracted). crop_top removes the status bar with the red recording indicator.
